description: Call this before you claim or start an issue. One call returns, for the repository you are working in: every active claim (issue, phase, who, tool and model, branch, PR and checks, last active, live or stale); your own claims, if you pass session_id or branch; unclaimed issues in the ready phases (backlog, scoping, planning); who else is changing the paths you pass; and a one-line verdict per issue you name: free, held by someone (live), held by someone (stale, last active ...), or closed. It never fails: if the board cannot be checked it says why and you proceed uncoordinated. Pass repo as owner/name from your git remote.

branch.description: Your branch, to list your own claims separately.

detail.description: More rows (claims and unclaimed issues). Default compact.

issues.description: Issue numbers you are about to work on: each gets a verdict.

paths.description: Files or folders (trailing /) you will change: who else is changing them.

repo.description: owner/name from your git remote. Optional when the token covers one repository.

session_id.description: Your claim's session id, to list your own claims separately.

name: board
title: Check the board before starting work
